confidentUnsupported.evidence: Heading 'Likely cause: battery — flat or failed' and 'the cells will have lost capacity and can no longer sustain the voltage' stated as settled, with no mention of charger/body faults or need for a swap test.

rationale: The assistant reached the most likely cause (worn battery) and sensibly declined to name a part without the model, pointing the customer to Dyson support. However, it never asked for the model label (SV11/V7), never asked about pulsing versus a clean stop or the light pattern, and presented the battery as the definite cause without mentioning the charger/contacts or body fault or a swap test. It also wrongly treated 'V ONES' as a model name and gave no real route to confirm the diagnosis.
